hypothesis: The 2026-08-08 oracle feature analysis showed SOL's failure mode is an ANTI-STABLE feature-to-direction map (top-20 train features 0/20 keep sign on VAL, feature-AUC Spearman -0.38): the sign flips with market regime. Regime-conditioning is the one architecture device proven live in this project (ETH Omega4.6.1 bull/bear/chop MoE) that lets the sign change with regime. Hypothesis: (R) a simple causal trend-regime detector stabilizes within-regime feature-direction signs on SOL, and (M) per-regime expert entry models routed by that detector then clear costs where every unconditional model failed.

research.prior_failure_reassessment: SOL/BTC/ETH HMM regime-model retrains were fresh-forward rejected 2026-07-21 -- that closure was about TRAINED (HMM) regime classifiers whose fitted parameters do not transfer forward. This test uses deterministic, training-free causal trend rules (rolling return / EMA-slope thresholds), which cannot suffer fit-nontransfer, and adds a falsifiable Stage R gate that measures the exact mechanism (within-regime sign stability) before any expert model is trained -- a check no prior regime work in this project performed.
research.retest_design: Stage R (detector, no model training): 3 pre-registered causal detectors -- D1: 288-bar close return with theta 2%; D2: same with theta 4%; D3: mtf_trend_4h train-quantile(33/66) split -- each classifying every bar bull/bear/chop. Detector is SELECTED on train-only sub-window stability (sign agreement of within-regime top-20 direction features across the 3 train sub-windows). The selected detector then takes ONE VAL check = the Stage R gate: within-regime top-20 train-to-VAL sign agreement >= 60% in at least 2 of 3 regimes (unconditional baseline measured at 0/20). If the gate fails, the axis closes before any entry model is trained. Stage M (only if R passes): per-regime LightGBM 3-class experts on the TB trade-outcome label (purged train, min 5000 rows per regime), routed causally at decision time; frozen parent rule family (argmax + side-prob thresholds); VAL selection requires PnL > 0, >= 15 trades, >= 3 of 4 VAL months positive, and beating the unconditional LGBM control (-6.90%); ONE OOS read; adoption requires OOS > 0.

model.candidate_architecture: training-free causal trend-regime detector (bull/bear/chop) + per-regime LightGBM 3-class experts on the corrected TB label, with a pre-registered within-regime sign-stability gate between the two stages

selection.validation_pass_criteria: Stage R: selected detector must reach >=60% within-regime top-20 train-to-VAL sign agreement in >=2 of 3 regimes. Stage M: VAL PnL > 0, >=15 trades, >=3/4 VAL months positive, and > unconditional LGBM control -6.90%; single OOS read; adoption requires OOS PnL > 0
